Title: Automate everything you do twice
Body: Build, test, deploy, backup and restore should be scripts or pipelines, not memory. Test the restore: an untested backup is a hope.

Title: Keep environments the same
Body: Use the same image and the same configuration shape in development, staging and production. Differences belong in configuration, not code.

Title: Make deploys small and reversible
Body: Small frequent releases with a quick rollback beat large rare ones. Know how to go back before you go forward.

Title: Alert on what users feel
Body: Page for symptoms (errors, latency, saturation) rather than every internal cause. Too many alerts teach people to ignore them.

Title: Treat secrets as secrets
Body: Never bake secrets into images or commit them. Inject at runtime from a secret store, rotate them, and scan history for leaks.
